scenes.speech: Your rules. Before your emotions. Meet Haki.
After installing Haki, select Get Started.
Make these rules your own. Edit a rule, or add another. Then continue.
Find your trading platform and turn protection on. Allow site access when your browser asks.
Choose how often Haki appears. Here, we're using every new trading tab.
Want your rules on every new tab? Turn this on, then finish setup.
Open your trading platform. Haki brings up your rules. Read and check each one, then select Ready to Trade.
Confirmed. Now you're back to your trading workspace.
And your new tab keeps those same rules within reach.
Powered by join Mirra dot app. Copy trade your prop firm accounts!
